objectives.description: Create .claude/scripts/literature-fidelity-audit.sh skeleton (set -euo pipefail, LITERATURE_DIR resolution, --dry-run/report-only default)
Enumerate the 97 sources/<dir>/ directories and classify presence of *.pdf/*.djvu and *.md
Implement DOCUMENT-LEVEL word-ratio (sum wc -w over ALL .md / sum pdftotext -layout words over ALL PDFs)
Emit a TSV/JSON report to stdout
REJECT chunk_*.md-presence and standalone ## Overview as signals

approaches_tried.approach: proof-completeness fraction with a simple '>=3 non-blank body lines counts as adequate' rule for ALL heading types
approaches_tried.reason: Counted rabinovich_2014's Lemma 3.2 (three bare unproved clauses, exactly the report's false-negative exemplar) as adequate since it has 3 non-blank lines with no Proof marker; produced proof_fraction=0.636, failing to flag rabinovich_2014 as unverified_summary.

approaches_tried.approach: require explicit 'Proof' marker for Lemma/Theorem/Proposition/Corollary claim headings (Definition headings use a >=2 non-blank-line/>=15-word content bar instead) with PROOF_ADEQUACY_THRESHOLD=0.5
approaches_tried.reason: Correctly excludes bare unproved clauses, but rabinovich_2014's actual proof_fraction came out to 0.545 (several of its later sections DO carry real 'Proof' text) — still >= 0.5, so it was not flagged.

approaches_tried.approach: same claim-vs-definition adequacy rule with PROOF_ADEQUACY_THRESHOLD=0.6
approaches_tried.reason: Reproduces the report's corrected population exactly: 52 no_source_pdf, 5 not_yet_converted, 4 unverified_no_baseline, 35 verified_conversion (30 healthy + 5 disclosed partials: doets_1987, libkin_2004_ch3_ch7, venema_1991, thomas_2003_reactive, hodkinson_2006), and exactly 1 unverified_summary (rabinovich_2014, proof_fraction=0.545 < 0.6). Zero false positives against the 5 named disclosed-partial benchmarks.
